questions.stem: What is potential difference defined as?

options.text: The rate of flow of charge through a circuit
The energy transferred per unit charge between two points
The total energy stored in a battery

questions.explanation: Potential difference (voltage) is defined as the energy transferred per unit charge between two points in a circuit. It is measured in volts (V), where 1 V = 1 J/C (one joule per coulomb).

questions.stem: How should a voltmeter be connected in a circuit to measure the potential difference across a component?

options.text: It does not matter how it is connected

questions.explanation: A voltmeter must be connected in parallel (across) the component whose potential difference you want to measure. This allows it to measure the difference in electrical potential between the two ends of the component.
